full_page.content:
c. 1910 - 1918
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 9
Pg. 27 Nov. 25th '10, (40 Anniversary) Birth Day Present and surprise after long drought a gentle though copious Rain & after, beautiful Thanksgiving-day, Deo Gratias.
Pg. 28 "We ought to will as He wills, but that is not all - we must will it when, where and how He sees best." "To act otherwise is to be like a sick man who attempts to dictate to his physician and prescribe his own remedies"-absurd (Chief sufferings p. 51)
Nov. 21st 1916 Today gave Rev. Fr. Walsh 25¢ and dinner. Same is twice "ex Jesuite", seeking a bishop. Resigned to his"misfortune" of failure against every effort where others succeed with less determination he pre- dicts with strongest conviction that having prayed from early child-hood for "Confidence in God" he will, in God's own time be Pope of Rome
June 29th "Most important quality for a real mis- sionary Humility - self-forgetfulness - all for Jesus."
June 16th 1918 Today appointed and permitted to be "Director of League" (after trying at least, to direct it for about ten years. Deo Gratias!)
Aug. 16th '18. Effected to be little conscious of beauty or success of sermon yesterday.
